checks.name: narrative_loop
checks.method: Read the full narration twice and checked exact ending + opening seam; independent reviewer confirmed the return to the wave image works.

observed.opening: On a winter day in 1919, a wave of molasses tore through Boston. But the real shock came after the flood.
observed.ending: So when you picture that Boston wave, remember what broke first: not just steel, but the assumption that somebody had checked it.

checks.name: viewer_value
checks.method: Compared the finished narration to the promise in research output and checked whether the payoff explains more than the curiosity hook.
